_about: Plans and prices for the whole website, in one place. node scripts/site.mjs writes them into every page's <!-- site:plans --> block. While published is false, prices show as 'Price to be announced'. Stripe holds the amount actually charged (STRIPE_PRICE_* in the platform), so change both together. Proposed by the maintainer on 30 Oct for review with Vinay (DEC-1, Tenwise/tenwise-platform#87, still open): Free, Reader $6/month or $60/year, Plus $12/month or $120/year. The Free plan (price 0) is proposed in DEC-6 (Tenwise/tenwise-platform#385), also open; the trial ends on Free instead of read-only.

plans.name: Free
plans.for: Follow your sources, read calmly and keep what matters, for as long as you like.
features: Up to 100 feeds, blogs and Google News searches
A dense list or a grid, and a calm docked reader
Unlimited saves with notes and highlights
AI with Gemini Nano in Chrome
One brief a month, to try them
Read, save and highlight on your phone
Download your whole library and your feeds (OPML), any time

plans.name: Reader
plans.for: For heavy readers: no limit on sources, your library organised and cited, and AI from your own key.
features: Unlimited feeds, blogs and Google News searches
Export your saves to Markdown and HTML
A daily digest email of what's new
AI with your own key, as well as Gemini Nano

plans.name: Plus
plans.for: For people who turn their reading into something they send: a weekly update, a client note, a newsletter.
features: Recurring briefs, drafted from your sources and the notes you choose
Every claim linked to the passage that supports it
Unsupported or conflicting claims flagged before you send
Approve, export, or share a brief by link
Tenwise AI included each month, no key needed
Studio newsletters and PDFs; Send to NotebookLM
